name: model-list-helper-layout-main
goal: Models use the existing helper-function card grid with scoped model and consumer links, retaining search, details, Source actions, and responsive behavior

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Daniel explicitly asked Models to match the existing helper-function lists. Current main routes models through ExplorerTable; reuse the existing ExplorerFunctionCard and responsive grid, keep search and consumer links, and keep source actions only on detail Source. Verify desktop 1440px, tablet 920px and mobile 390px.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Models are routed through the existing ExplorerFunctionCard helper grid; the fixture contains Order and Invoice, and the catalog still retains search, filters, detail navigation, and consumer links.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red: the unchanged browser scenario failed at desktop, tablet, and mobile when it required 2 model cards and found 1. Green: TAKE_SCREENSHOT=1 ENTITY_PREVIEW_SHOTS=/tmp/harness-model-list-final-20261022 SCREENSHOT_LABEL=main-models bun run --cwd packages/reports test:entities --grep 'models, components, helpers and services use a card grid' passed 3/3; desktop and mobile captures were inspected and show Order and Invoice.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
Exercise the affected UI path, require no unexpected browser errors, and capture fresh evidence with error diagnostics.
steps.evidence: Playwright exercised the model grid, search, shared filter, consumer link, and model detail at 1440x900, 834x1112, and 390x844. All 3 viewport cases passed; fresh desktop/tablet/mobile screenshots were captured, and desktop/mobile pixels were inspected.
